description.padding: Space between the edge of the element and its content. Increase it to give content more breathing room.
description.margin: Space outside the element, pushing it away from its neighbors.
description.paddingLeft: Adds space between the left edge of the element and its content.
description.paddingRight: Adds space between the right edge of the element and its content.
description.paddingTop: Adds space between the top edge of the element and its content.
description.paddingBottom: Adds space between the bottom edge of the element and its content.
description.marginLeft: Pushes the element away from its left neighbor.
description.marginRight: Pushes the element away from its right neighbor.
description.marginTop: Pushes the element away from its top neighbor.
description.marginBottom: Pushes the element away from its bottom neighbor.
description.borderRadius: Rounds the corners of the element. Higher values make corners softer.
description.borderRadiusTopLeft: Rounds only the top-left corner of the element.
description.borderRadiusTopRight: Rounds only the top-right corner of the element.
description.borderRadiusBottomLeft: Rounds only the bottom-left corner of the element.
description.borderRadiusBottomRight: Rounds only the bottom-right corner of the element.
description.fontSize: Controls how large the text renders.
description.fontWeight: Controls how bold the text appears.
description.lineHeight: Vertical space between lines of text. Higher values add breathing room for multi-line text.
description.lineClamp: Maximum number of lines shown before the text is cut off and collapsed, with the rest hidden.
description.textAlign: Aligns the text itself — left, center, right, or justified — within its own line box.
description.textStyle: Toggles bold, italic, underline, and list formatting for the selected text.
description.script: Shrinks and raises or lowers text, useful for exponents, footnotes, and ordinals.
description.strokeWidth: Thickness of the icon's outline strokes. Higher values make the icon look bolder.
description.alignX: Moves content left, center, or right within its container.
description.alignY: Moves content to the top, middle, or bottom of its container.
description.backgroundColor: Fills the element behind its content.
description.textColor: Changes the color of the text.
description.borderColor: Changes the color of the element's outline/border.
description.opacity: Controls transparency. Lower values make the element more see-through.
description.rotate: Rotates the element around its center.
description.gap: Space between items inside a container, like a row of images or buttons.
description.width: Controls how wide the element is.
description.height: Controls how tall the element is.
description.minWidth: The narrowest the element is allowed to shrink to, even if its content or container gets smaller.
description.maxWidth: The widest the element is allowed to grow to, even if its content or container is larger.
description.minHeight: The shortest the element is allowed to shrink to, even if its content takes up less space.
description.maxHeight: The tallest the element is allowed to grow to, even if its content needs more space.
description.columns: Number of columns items are arranged into.
description.rows: Number of rows items are arranged into.
description.gridCellSpan: Controls how many columns/rows this element spans inside its grid parent, and which line it starts on.
description.gridColumnStart: Which vertical grid line this element begins on, counting from 1. Leave blank to let the grid auto-place it.
description.gridColumnSpan: How many columns wide this element stretches, starting from its column start line.
description.gridRowStart: Which horizontal grid line this element begins on, counting from 1. Leave blank to let the grid auto-place it.
description.gridRowSpan: How many rows tall this element stretches, starting from its row start line.
description.objectFit: Controls how an image/video fills its box — stretched to fill, or scaled to fit without cropping.
description.shadow: Adds a drop shadow beneath the element for depth.
description.direction: Arranges items in a row or a column.
description.layoutType: How children are arranged: a flex row, a flex column, or a fully customizable grid.
description.gridAutoFlow: Controls whether items not explicitly placed fill the grid row-by-row or column-by-column.
description.scaleZoom: Makes the element larger or smaller without changing its layout size.
description.colorPair: Swaps between two colors for this element's states.
description.collapse: Lets the section fold open or closed.
description.positionOffset: Nudges the element from its normal spot by a horizontal (X) and vertical (Y) amount.
description.positionOffsetX: Nudges the element left or right from its normal position.
description.positionOffsetY: Nudges the element up or down from its normal position.
description.positionLeft: Sets how far the element sits from the left edge of its positioned container.
description.positionRight: Sets how far the element sits from the right edge of its positioned container.
description.positionTop: Sets how far the element sits from the top edge of its positioned container.
description.positionBottom: Sets how far the element sits from the bottom edge of its positioned container.
description.animation: Makes the element move, fade, or scale in when a trigger (like page load or scroll) happens.
description.scrollTo: When triggered, smoothly scrolls the page to another element you pick — great for prototyping click-through flows.
description.prototypeAction: When triggered, acts on another element you pick — scroll to it, show/hide/toggle it, or reveal it with a slide or fade.
description.shadowConfig: Adds a drop shadow. Offset moves it, blur softens it, spread grows it, and color tints it.
description.shadowOffset: Moves the shadow horizontally (X) and vertically (Y) relative to the element.
description.shadowBlur: Softens the edges of the shadow. Higher values make it fuzzier and more spread out.
description.shadowSpread: Grows or shrinks the shadow shape itself, independent of blur.
description.shadowColor: Changes the tint of the shadow.
description.styleGroup: Visual appearance — background, borders, and corner rounding for this element.
description.typographyGroup: Text appearance — font, size, weight, and styling for this element's text.
description.showCta: Shows or hides the Call To Action button without losing its label or link.
description.brandDisplayMode: Switches the brand between plain text and an uploaded logo image.
description.zIndex: Controls which positioned element sits on top when two overlap — higher stacks above lower.
description.animationTiming: How long the effect takes (duration) and how long it waits before starting (delay). Drag the bars on the timeline to change them visually.
description.animationEasing: The speed curve of the effect. Drag the two handles to make it start slow, overshoot, or snap into place.
description.animationPreset: A ready-made animation. Entrance presets reveal the element; attention presets draw the eye and can repeat.
description.skew: Slants the element horizontally (X) or vertically (Y).
description.blur: Softens the element. Blur 0 is sharp; higher values get fuzzier.
description.iconSearch: Type a word like "home" or "arrow" to search over 200,000 icons from many icon sets, then click one to use it.
